title: Italian parliament votes for return to nuclear energy
why_read: This is a policy and energy story rather than a software engineering topic, so it's mostly off-topic for a technical digest despite being a substantive political development.
analysis: The item reports on the Italian parliament voting to reverse its decades-long ban on nuclear power, a significant energy-policy shift. While nuclear engineering has technical dimensions, this news item is fundamentally political and regulatory rather than about software or systems engineering. It may interest engineers broadly concerned with energy infrastructure, but it doesn't offer technical substance for a software-focused digest. Its high engagement on HN likely reflects general interest in energy politics rather than technical content.
